content.comment_body: Hello, I purchased a new [product_name] controller with order code [article_no] and installed [product_name] software [version_no] on my laptop. I edited a program and now want to transfer it from my laptop software to the controller. However, when I access the settings on the device, only options to transfer between card and controller are available; there is no option for transferring directly between PC and controller. When I try to transfer using the card to controller mode, I receive an 'unknown card' message. Can anyone advise what might be causing this issue?

Hi [user_name], with your [product_name] controller, you no longer need to set it into a special mode for transferring programs. Simply click the upload or download button in your software. If the display shows 'No program, press ESC', please follow the device's instructions.

1. I am not using simulation mode. 2. The manual recommends switching the device to PC-to-controller mode first, but my device does not offer that mode. When I connect directly, an error message appears in the [product_name] software: 'Interface selection error. Please check: Mode of the controller: PC to controller; the cable connecting the PC and controller.' The lack of a PC to controller mode seems to be the issue.

Hi, The manual, specifically chapter 7, explains how to put your controller into transfer mode. To switch to the PC↔controller mode: 1. Use the PC software to switch the device with or without display to STOP, or select the ESC/Stop command on a device with display and confirm. When the controller is in STOP and connected to the PC, these commands are accepted: - Switch controller to RUN - Read/write the program - Adjust summertime/wintertime settings. For further details, refer to the manual: [document]

Thank you everyone. I discovered that the issue was with my COM port. When I used my desktop computer and connected the controller to its COM port, the program transferred successfully. Thanks again, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user had trouble transferring a program from PC to a controller using [product_name] software, facing issues due to missing mode options and error messages. The core problem was unclear transfer settings and a lack of guidance regarding connection requirements, specifically COM port configuration. The situation was resolved when the user switched from a laptop to a desktop, revealing the COM port as the source of the problem.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects a simple and well-explained transfer process from PC to controller, with clear mode selection and reliable software-to-hardware communication.
